1.english_reference: Seven years old [ was ] Jehoash when he began to reign .

traditions.WLC: בֶּן שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים יְהוֹאָ֥שׁ בְּ מָלְכֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν Ἰωὰς τὸ εὐθὲς ἐνώπιον Κυρίου πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἃς ἐφώτισεν αὐτὸν Ἰωδᾶε ὁ ἱερεύς .
traditions.VUL: Septémque annórum erat Ioas , cum regnáre cœpísset .
traditions.KJV: Seven years old [ was ] Jehoash when he began to reign .

2.english_reference: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign ;

traditions.WLC: בִּ שְׁנַת שֶׁ֤בַע לְ יֵהוּא֙ מָלַ֣ךְ יְהוֹאָ֔שׁ
traditions.LXX: πλὴν τῶν ὑψηλῶν οὐ μετεστάθησαν ,
traditions.VUL: Anno séptimo Iehu , regnávit Ioas :
traditions.KJV: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign ;

2.english_reference: and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem .

traditions.WLC: וְ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκεῖ ἔτι ὁ λαὸς ἐθυσίασαν καὶ ἐθυμίων ἐν τοῖς ὑψηλοῖς .
traditions.VUL: et quadragínta annis regnávit in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem .

2.english_reference: And his mother ’s name [ was ] Zibiah of Beersheba .

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔ וֹ צִבְיָ֖ה מִ בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע
traditions.VUL: Nomen matris eius Sebía de Bersabée .
traditions.KJV: And his mother ’s name [ was ] Zibiah of Beersheba .

3.english_reference: And Jehoash did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD all his days

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֨עַשׂ יְהוֹאָ֧שׁ הַ יָּשָׁ֛ר בְּ עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כָּל יָמָ֑י
traditions.LXX: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἰωὰς πρὸς τοὺς ἱερεῖς Πᾶν τὸ ἀργύριον τῶν ἁγίων τὸ εἰσοδιαζόμενον ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Κυρίου ἀργύριον συντιμήσεως , ἀνὴρ ἀργύριον λαβὼν συντιμήσεως , πᾶν ἀργύριον ὃ ἐὰν λάβῃ ἐπὶ καρδίαν ἀνδρὸς ἐνεγκεῖν ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Fecítque Ioas rectum coram Dómino cunctis diébus ,
traditions.KJV: And Jehoash did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD all his days

3.english_reference: wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him .

traditions.WLC: ו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹרָ֔ הוּ יְהוֹיָדָ֖ע הַ כֹּהֵֽן
traditions.VUL: quibus dócuit eum Ióiada sacérdos .
traditions.KJV: wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him .

4.english_reference: But the high places were not taken away :

traditions.WLC: רַ֥ק הַ בָּמ֖וֹת לֹא סָ֑רוּ
traditions.LXX: λαβέτωσαν ἑαυτοῖς οἱ ἱερεῖς ἀνὴρ ἀπὸ τῆς πράσεως αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Verúmtamen excélsa non ábstulit :
traditions.KJV: But the high places were not taken away :

4.english_reference: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places .

traditions.WLC: ע֥וֹד הָ עָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽ מְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּ בָּמֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ αὐτοὶ κρατήσουσιν τὸ βέδεκ τοῦ οἴκου εἰς πάντα οὗ ἐὰν εὑρεθῇ ἐκεῖ βέδεκ .
traditions.VUL: adhuc enim pópulus immolábat , et adolébat in excélsis incénsum .
traditions.KJV: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places .

5.english_reference: And Jehoash said to the priests ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹאָ֜שׁ אֶל הַ כֹּהֲנִ֗ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῷ εἰκοστῷ καὶ τρίτῳ ἔτει τῷ βασιλεῖ Ἰωὰς οὐκ ἐκραταίωσαν οἱ ἱερεῖς τὸ βέδεκ τοῦ οἴκου .
traditions.VUL: Dixítque Ioas ad sacerdótes :
traditions.KJV: And Jehoash said to the priests ,

5.english_reference: All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּל֩ כֶּ֨סֶף הַ קֳּדָשִׁ֜ים אֲשֶׁר יוּבָ֤א בֵית יְהוָה֙
traditions.VUL: Omnem pecúniam sanctórum , quæ illáta fúerit in templum Dómini
traditions.KJV: All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the LORD , [ even ]

5.english_reference: [ even ] the money of every one that passeth [ the account ] ,

traditions.WLC: כֶּ֣סֶף עוֹבֵ֔ר אִ֕ישׁ
traditions.VUL: a prætereúntibus ,
traditions.KJV: the money of every one that passeth [

5.english_reference: the money that every man is set at ,

traditions.WLC: כֶּ֥סֶף נַפְשׁ֖וֹת עֶרְכּ֑ וֹ
traditions.VUL: quæ offértur pro prétio ánimæ ,
traditions.KJV: the account ] , the money that every man is set at , [ and ]

5.english_reference: [ and ] all the money that cometh into any man ’s heart to bring into the house of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: כָּל כֶּ֗סֶף אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַֽעֲלֶה֙ עַ֣ל לֶב אִ֔ישׁ לְ הָבִ֖יא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: et quam sponte et arbítrio cordis sui ínferunt in templum Dómini :
traditions.KJV: all the money that cometh into any man ’s heart to bring into the house of the LORD ,

6.english_reference: Let the priests take [ it ] to them , every man of his acquaintance :

traditions.WLC: יִקְח֤וּ לָ הֶם֙ הַ כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אִ֖ישׁ מֵ אֵ֣ת מַכָּר֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ἰωὰς ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἰωδᾶε τὸν ἱερέα καὶ τοὺς ἱερεῖς , καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Τί ὅτι οὐκ ἐκραταιοῦτε τὸ βέδεκ τοῦ οἴκου ; καὶ νῦν μὴ λάβητε ἀργύριον ἀπὸ τῶν πράσεων ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: accípiant illam sacerdótes iuxta órdinem suum ,
traditions.KJV: Let the priests take [ it ] to them , every man of his acquaintance :

6.english_reference: and let them repair the breaches of the house , wheresoever any breach shall be found .

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵ֗ם יְחַזְּקוּ֙ אֶת בֶּ֣דֶק הַ בַּ֔יִת לְ כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יִמָּצֵ֥א שָׁ֖ם בָּֽדֶק
traditions.LXX: ὅτι εἰς τὸ βέδεκ τοῦ οἴκου δώσετε αὐτό .
traditions.VUL: et instáurent sartatécta domus , si quid necessárium víderint instauratióne .
traditions.KJV: and let them repair the breaches of the house , wheresoever any breach shall be found .

7.english_reference: But it was [ so , that ] in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֗י בִּ שְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְ שָׁלֹ֛שׁ שָׁנָ֖ה לַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹאָ֑שׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνεφώνησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς τοῦ μὴ λαβεῖν ἀργύριον παρὰ τοῦ λαοῦ
traditions.VUL: Igitur usque ad vigésimum tértium annum regis Ioas ,
traditions.KJV: But it was [ so , that ] in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash

7.english_reference: the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house .

traditions.WLC: לֹֽא חִזְּק֥וּ הַ כֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת בֶּ֥דֶק הַ בָּֽיִת
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῦ μὴ ἐνισχῦσαι τὸ βδέλυγμα τοῦ οἴκου .
traditions.VUL: non instauravérunt sacerdótes sartatécta templi .
traditions.KJV: the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house .

8.english_reference: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest , and the [ other ] priests , and said unto them ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרָא֩ הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ יְהוֹאָ֜שׁ לִ יהוֹיָדָ֤ע הַ כֹּהֵן֙ וְ לַ כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἰωδᾶε ὁ ἱερεὺς κιβωτὸν μίαν , καὶ ἔτρησεν τρὼγλην ἐν τῇ τρώγλῃ αὐτῆς ,
traditions.VUL: Vocavítque rex Ioas Ióiadam pontíficem et sacerdótes , dicens eis :
traditions.KJV: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest , and the [ other ] priests , and said unto them ,

8.english_reference: Why repair ye not the breaches of the house ?

traditions.WLC: מַדּ֛וּעַ אֵינְ כֶ֥ם מְחַזְּקִ֖ים אֶת בֶּ֣דֶק הַ בָּ֑יִת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκαν οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ φυλάσσοντες τὸν σταθμὸν πᾶν τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ εὑρεθὲν ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: Quare sartatécta non instaurátis templi ?
traditions.KJV: Why repair ye not the breaches of the house ?

8.english_reference: now therefore receive no [ more ] money of your acquaintance ,

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֗ה אַל תִּקְחוּ כֶ֨סֶף֙ מֵ אֵ֣ת מַכָּֽרֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.VUL: nolíte ergo ámplius accípere pecúniam iuxta órdinem vestrum ,
traditions.KJV: now therefore receive no [ more ] money of your acquaintance ,

8.english_reference: but deliver it for the breaches of the house .

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי לְ בֶ֥דֶק הַ בַּ֖יִת תִּתְּנֻֽ הוּ
traditions.VUL: sed ad instauratiónem templi réddite eam .
traditions.KJV: but deliver it for the breaches of the house .

9.english_reference: And the priests consented to receive no [ more ] money of the people ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּאֹ֖תוּ הַ כֹּֽהֲנִ֑ים לְ בִלְתִּ֤י קְחַת כֶּ֨סֶף֙ מֵ אֵ֣ת הָ עָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς εἶδεν ὅτι πολὺ τὸ ἀργύριον ἐν τῇ κιβωτῷ , καὶ ἀνέβη ὁ γραμματεὺς τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ μέγας ,
traditions.VUL: Prohibitíque sunt sacerdótes ultra accípere pecúniam a pópulo ,
traditions.KJV: And the priests consented to receive no [ more ] money of the people ,

9.english_reference: neither to repair the breaches of the house .

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ בִלְתִּ֥י חַזֵּ֖ק אֶת בֶּ֥דֶק הַ בָּֽיִת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσφιγξαν καὶ ἠρίθμησαν τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ εὑρεθὲν ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: et instauráre sartatécta domus .
traditions.KJV: neither to repair the breaches of the house .

10.english_reference: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest , and bored a hole in the lid of it ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקַּ֞ח יְהוֹיָדָ֤ע הַ כֹּהֵן֙ אֲר֣וֹן אֶחָ֔ד וַ יִּקֹּ֥ב חֹ֖ר בְּ דַלְתּ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ ἑτοιμασθὲν ἐπὶ χεῖρας ποιούντων τὰ ἔργα τῶν ἐπισκόπων οἴκου Κυρίου ·
traditions.VUL: Et tulit Ióiada póntifex gazophylácium unum , aperuítque forámen désuper ,
traditions.KJV: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest , and bored a hole in the lid of it ,

10.english_reference: and set it beside the altar , on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD :

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֵּ֣ן אֹת וֹ֩ אֵ֨צֶל הַ מִּזְבֵּ֜חַ ב ימין בְּ בֽוֹא אִישׁ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐχέδοσαν τοῖς τέκτοσιν τῶν ξύλων καὶ τοῖς οἰκοδόμοις τοῖς ποιοῦσιν ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: et pósuit illud iuxta altáre ad déxteram ingrediéntium domum Dómini :
traditions.KJV: and set it beside the altar , on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD :

10.english_reference: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money [ that was ] brought into the house of the LORD .

traditions.WLC: וְ נָֽתְנוּ שָׁ֤מָּ ה הַ כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ שֹׁמְרֵ֣י הַ סַּ֔ף אֶת כָּל הַ כֶּ֖סֶף הַ מּוּבָ֥א בֵית יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: mittebántque in eo sacerdótes , qui custodiébant óstia , omnem pecúniam , quæ deferebátur ad templum Dómini .
traditions.KJV: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money [ that was ] brought into the house of the LORD .

11.english_reference: And it was [ so ] , when they saw that [ there was ] much money in the chest ,

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְהִי֙ כִּ רְאוֹתָ֔ ם כִּֽי רַ֥ב הַ כֶּ֖סֶף בָּֽ אָר֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῖς τειχισταῖς καὶ τοῖς λατόμοις τῶν λίθων , τοῦ κτήσασθαι ξύλα καὶ λίθους λατομητοὺς
traditions.VUL: Cumque vidérent nímiam pecúniam esse in gazophylácio ,
traditions.KJV: And it was [ so ] , when they saw that [ there was ] much money in the chest ,

11.english_reference: that the king ’s scribe and the high priest came up ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֨עַל סֹפֵ֤ר הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ הַ כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ גָּד֔וֹל
traditions.LXX: τοῦ κατασχεῖν τὸ βέδεκ οἴκου Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: ascendébat scriba regis , et póntifex ,
traditions.KJV: that the king ’s scribe and the high priest came up ,

11.english_reference: and they put up in bags , and told the money that was found in the house of the LORD .

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּצֻ֨רוּ֙ וַ יִּמְנ֔וּ אֶת הַ כֶּ֖סֶף הַ נִּמְצָ֥א בֵית יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: εἰς πάντα ὅσα ἐξωδιάσθη ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ κραταιῶσαι .
traditions.VUL: effundebántque et numerábant pecúniam , quæ inveniebátur in domo Dómini :
traditions.KJV: and they put up in bags , and told the money that was found in the house of the LORD .

12.english_reference: And they gave the money , being told , into the hands of them that did the work ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתְנוּ֙ אֶת הַ כֶּ֣סֶף הַֽ מְתֻכָּ֔ן עַל יד עֹשֵׂ֣י הַ מְּלָאכָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: πλὴν οὐ ποιηθήσεται οἴκῳ Κυρίου θύραι ἀργυραῖ , ἧλοι , φιάλαι καὶ σάλπιγγες ,
traditions.VUL: et dabant eam iuxta númerum atque mensúram in manu eórum , qui prǽerant cæmentáriis domus Dómini :
traditions.KJV: And they gave the money , being told , into the hands of them that did the work ,

12.english_reference: that had the oversight of the house of the LORD :

traditions.WLC: ה פקדים בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: πᾶν σκεῦος χρυσοῦν καὶ σκεῦος ἀργυροῦν ,
traditions.VUL: qui impendébant eam in fabris lignórum ,
traditions.KJV: that had the oversight of the house of the LORD :

12.english_reference: and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders , that wrought upon the house of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יּוֹצִיאֻ֜ הוּ לְ חָרָשֵׁ֤י הָ עֵץ֙ וְ לַ בֹּנִ֔ים הָ עֹשִׂ֖ים בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐκ τοῦ ἀργυρίου τοῦ εἰσενεχθέντος ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου ·
traditions.VUL: et in cæmentáriis iis , qui operabántur in domo Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders , that wrought upon the house of the LORD ,

13.english_reference: And to masons , and hewers of stone ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ גֹּֽדְרִים֙ וּ לְ חֹצְבֵ֣י הָ אֶ֔בֶן
traditions.LXX: ὅτι τοῖς ποιοῦσιν τὰ ἔργα δώσουσιν αὐτὸ .
traditions.VUL: et sartatécta faciébant : et in iis , qui cædébant saxa ,
traditions.KJV: And to masons , and hewers of stone ,

13.english_reference: and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לִ קְנ֤וֹת עֵצִים֙ וְ אַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב לְ חַזֵּ֖ק אֶת בֶּ֣דֶק בֵּית יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: et ut émerent ligna , et lápides , qui excidebántur , ita ut implerétur instaurátio domus Dómini
traditions.KJV: and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the LORD ,

13.english_reference: and for all that was laid out for the house to repair [ it ] .

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵ֥א עַל הַ בַּ֖יִת לְ חָזְקָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκραταίωσαν ἐν αὐτῷ τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: in univérsis , quæ indigébant expénsa ad muniéndam domum .
traditions.KJV: and for all that was laid out for the house to repair [ it ] .

14.english_reference: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the LORD bowls of silver , snuffers , basons , trumpets ,

traditions.WLC: אַךְ֩ לֹ֨א יֵעָשֶׂ֜ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֗ה סִפּ֥וֹת כֶּ֨סֶף֙ מְזַמְּר֤וֹת מִזְרָקוֹת֙ חֲצֹ֣צְר֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐξελογίζοντο τοὺς ἄνδρας οἷς ἐδίδουν τὸ ἀργύριον
traditions.VUL: Verúmtamen non fiébant ex eádem pecúnia hýdriæ templi Dómini , et fuscínulæ , et thuríbula , et tubæ ,
traditions.KJV: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the LORD bowls of silver , snuffers , basons , trumpets ,

14.english_reference: any vessels of gold , or vessels of silver ,

traditions.WLC: כָּל כְּלִ֥י זָהָ֖ב וּ כְלִי כָ֑סֶף
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ χεῖρας αὐτῶν δοῦναι τοῖς ποιοῦσιν τὰ ἔργα ,
traditions.VUL: et omne vas áureum et argénteum
traditions.KJV: any vessels of gold , or vessels of silver ,

14.english_reference: of the money [ that was ] brought into the house of the LORD :

traditions.WLC: מִן הַ כֶּ֖סֶף הַ מּוּבָ֥א בֵית יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐν πίστει αὐτῶν ποιοῦσιν .
